review.statement: The phase, capabilities, workstreams, limits, repository-backed application deployment claim, mandatory same-task cross-repository documentation handoff, tiered project hooks, quiet global resume and compaction refresh, isolated-worktree guidance, and the higher-quality first-person homepage demonstration pipeline were reviewed together against the current implementation and documentation. The v15 separate landing-page demonstration was published from private repository commit ef120516f84fc31c9c59b29a9b09e4b3aeaa6d1c and verified through its Lenovo origin and public Cloudflare route on 2026-08-31; exact media bytes, headers, markup and ranges were verified, while a fresh interactive browser pass was unavailable and application-service health was not probed by this review.

project.milestone: Post-M17 handoff; M-18 legacy-retirement decision remains gated
project.summary: The standalone Chalkwright service is documented as the classroom display source of truth. The separate narrated public landing page is now published with canonical private Git history, while current application-repository work continues on stabilization, demonstration reproducibility, synthetic fixture presentation, and the self-documenting development workflow.

deployment.summary: Repository evidence says the standalone production lane serves the existing classroom display path, provider acquisition and owned-Calendar follower jobs are active, and the historical shadow remains rollback-only.
deployment.evidenceBasis: Reviewed repository documentation dated through 2026-08-31. This refresh directly verified the separate landing page through its loopback and public routes, including exact v15 media bytes, headers, markup and bounded ranges. A fresh interactive browser pass was unavailable, and no application-service, provider, credential, or classroom-display probe was performed.

priorities: Keep the production handoff stable and preserve recovery evidence before any separately approved M-18 retirement of the shadow fallback.
Make the repository's present state, capabilities, workstreams, limitations, and verification status continuously available to Codex.
Keep the published privacy-safe landing page reproducible, accessible, independently versioned, and operationally separate from application releases.
Continue bounded enrichment work for learning objectives, lesson references, vocabulary, and setup usability without broadening provider authority.
knownLimits: General installation support and public-production readiness for external adopters are not claimed.
The retained historical shadow has not been authorized for M-18 retirement.
PowerSchool and Google Classroom remain read-only; Calendar writes remain limited to verified application-owned events.

Semantic documentation accuracy is a mandatory model-reviewed completion condition; documented deployment claims still require a separately authorized live probe before being reported as current live state.
The current strict configuration schemas are not yet the intended guided end-user setup experience.
nextDecisions: Whether stabilization and recovery evidence are sufficient to authorize the separately bounded M-18 legacy-fallback retirement.
What maintenance and contribution workflow should govern the now-published landing page as Chalkwright approaches broader installation support.
Which post-MVP enrichment or guided-setup slice should follow the current stabilization and presentation work.

capabilities.name: Canonical schedule and day-plan orchestration
capabilities.summary: Normalizes trusted schedule observations into a provider-neutral canonical day plan and derives deterministic effective plans.
capabilities.safety: Provider observations are read-only inputs; invalid or unavailable observations fail closed and preserve last-known-good state.

capabilities.name: Schedule-aware classroom display
capabilities.summary: Serves responsive morning, coming-up, check-in, in-class, transition, dismissal, gap, and day-complete views with deterministic timing.
capabilities.safety: The fixture route is loopback-only by default; production serving and route changes remain separately controlled.

capabilities.name: PowerSchool schedule acquisition
capabilities.summary: Acquires bounded bell and schedule data through passive, manual-repair, just-in-time-repair, and compatibility lanes.
capabilities.safety: PowerSchool is strictly read-only; browser/session repair is isolated from normal collection and protected state remains outside Git.

capabilities.name: Google Classroom assignment enrichment
capabilities.summary: Refreshes read-only Classroom coursework into a local cache and projects relevant assignments without blocking display responses.
capabilities.safety: Scopes and adapters are read-only; provider failure retains cached content and cannot create or modify coursework.

capabilities.name: Application-owned Calendar reconciliation
capabilities.summary: Projects the canonical plan into explicitly owned Calendar events with a single writer, leases, journals, receipts, idempotency, and rollback evidence.
capabilities.safety: Writes are limited to exact configured targets and verified Chalkwright-owned events; unrelated events and calendars are denied.

capabilities.name: Meeting-scoped attendance check-in presentation
capabilities.summary: Presents class-scoped attendance links, response context, and QR codes for students to use on their own devices.
capabilities.safety: Chalkwright displays check-in context but does not submit attendance to PowerSchool or another school system.

capabilities.name: Learning objectives, lesson references, and vocabulary
capabilities.summary: Imports bounded teacher-authored objectives and glossary data, selects deterministic vocabulary, and displays multilingual lesson content.
capabilities.safety: Imports are bounded and provenance-aware; ambiguity preserves prior fallbacks and no LLM or provider write is required.

capabilities.name: Preview, overrides, and carousel controls
capabilities.summary: Supports future or frozen-time preview, scoped local overrides, and server-controlled carousel holds isolated by screen and date.
capabilities.safety: Preview and report-only paths cannot acquire mutation authority; override scope is validated and persisted locally.

capabilities.name: Durable state, recovery, and last-known-good behavior
capabilities.summary: Uses SQLite migrations, integrity checks, backups, retention, restart-safe jobs, and last-known-good projections.
capabilities.safety: Credentials and browser profiles stay outside SQLite and Git; recovery paths validate state before activation.

capabilities.name: Immutable production deployment and rollback
capabilities.summary: Builds digest-bound releases, polls protected main, verifies readiness, switches atomically, and rolls back failed releases.
capabilities.safety: Merge, deployment, route, and activation effects remain explicitly authorized operations with fail-closed gates.

capabilities.name: School branding and bounded site media
capabilities.summary: Supports an installation-specific school logo, course art, countdown media, local validation, and digest-pinned serving.
capabilities.safety: Remote inputs become owner-only validated local files; public repository media remains synthetic or provenance-gated.

capabilities.name: Synthetic local evaluation and public demonstration
capabilities.summary: Provides a loopback-only B407 demonstration, reproducible screenshots, privacy-safe homepage media, smoke checks, and disposable rehearsals.
capabilities.safety: Fixtures and captures contain no student, provider, credential, private-route, or production database data.

capabilities.name: Guided non-secret installation configuration
capabilities.summary: Replace direct editing of strict runtime files with a versioned, approachable setup layer while retaining protected secret separation.
capabilities.safety: The planned layer must not combine OAuth material, tokens, browser profiles, or private provider values with non-secret configuration.

capabilities.name: Historical shadow retirement
capabilities.summary: Retire the rollback-only historical shadow after stabilization, recovery proof, and an explicitly approved M-18 boundary.
capabilities.safety: No retirement, service stop, route removal, or state deletion is authorized by documentation or implementation alone.

capabilities.name: Attendance administration workflow
capabilities.summary: An operator-facing attendance administration workflow remains deliberately outside the current production scope.
capabilities.safety: Any future workflow must preserve read-only school-system boundaries and must not infer authority from existing aggregate continuity data.

workstreams.name: Obsessively self-documenting development workflow
workstreams.outcome: Keep semantic project state and capability knowledge current, enforced, and directly available inside every Codex task.
workstreams.currentState: The generated documentation router, tiered session and prompt hooks, quiet resume/compaction host refresh, path watcher, timer, semantic state registry, implementation-fingerprint gate, workstream classification, mandatory same-task cross-repository landing-page handoff, and isolated-worktree guidance are active.
nextSteps: Maintain the registry and relevant durable prose with every implementation change, acknowledge each new implementation fingerprint only after semantic review, and keep the complete verification chain green.

workstreams.name: Privacy-safe homepage demonstration
workstreams.outcome: Produce reproducible, accessible, privacy-safe media that explains Chalkwright accurately on the separate public landing page.
workstreams.currentState: Synthetic storyboards, narration/render tooling, provenance boundaries, and landing-page operating instructions remain an active application-repository workstream. The published 123-second native-1080p v15 cut follows one coherent day: Web Design appears in the first coming-up state and completes its class sequence before the later Robotics sequence and Robotics dismissal. Its Web Design opening uses a measured natural clause pause; the Classroom-to-vocabulary handoff uses a short continuous breath without a fade. Every captured display state uses the ChalkWright logo as the unconfigured school-brand placeholder. The Robotics sequence animates its explicitly labeled Google Classroom assignment, task details, and due date before its translation faces; the assignment remains stable through the edit instead of beginning an automatic card advance during its final frames. The translation faces remain synchronized to narration-topic boundaries without repeating the language enumeration. Displayed demo branding uses ChalkWright casing, the schedule narration says the day's complete schedule, and the closing voice explicitly says Apache two point oh. The live v15 release removes the unspoken fourth overview bullet, retimes each anatomy callout to lead its matching spoken phrase by about 0.2 seconds, lets the final full-screen pullback settle after narration, introduces the second class with the authentic Robotics coming-up display, accelerates its runtime-formatted lower-left countdown from 10:00 to 0:00, holds at zero before dissolving into its objective, shortens the following narration to avoid repeating the Robotics class name, and adds an explicit sentence break before the classroom-specific language explanation. The separate private landing-page repository records deployed runtime source commit ef120516f84fc31c9c59b29a9b09e4b3aeaa6d1c. The Lenovo origin and public Cloudflare route were verified on 2026-08-31, including exact video and caption hashes, text/vtt caption delivery, HTTP 206 bounded video ranges, release-tokened markup and a zero-finding production dependency audit. A fresh interactive live browser pass was unavailable; the unchanged player UI and v15 media retain their prior local visual verification. Authorized cleanup removed superseded v13/v14 render packages, v8/v9 narration sets and reproducible Docker build cache. After v15 verification, the user explicitly requested removal of latent obsolete production video copies, so the unused predecessor Docker image was deleted; canonical Git history remains the prior-release recovery source. Future landing-page changes require their canonical application documentation and semantic-state handoff within the same task.
nextSteps: Maintain reproducible media provenance, caption accuracy, public delivery checks and independent landing-page source history as the demonstration evolves.

workstreams.name: Synthetic display-content polish
workstreams.outcome: Keep fixture-backed captures representative of current objectives, assignments, and multilingual vocabulary without introducing private classroom data.
workstreams.currentState: The B407 synthetic fixture and preview evidence include richer Web Design and Robotics carousel content. Coursework retains an explicit Google Classroom presentation, the Robotics assignment includes synthetic task and due-date details, and an unconfigured school-brand slot uses the ChalkWright placeholder logo; corresponding display assertions are updated.
nextSteps: Verify the accepted viewport envelope and regenerate only reproducible synthetic preview evidence when presentation behavior changes.
